name: Tests

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    tags: ["*"]
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:
  schedule:
    # Rerun CI in order to detect flaky tests. Note that all packages are pinned, so
    # these scheduled runs are unaffected by upstream releases.
    # The upstream.yml workflow will instead pick up upstream changes.
    - cron: "0 6,18 * * *"

# When this workflow is queued, automatically cancel any previous running
# or pending jobs from the same branch
concurrency:
  group: tests-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  test:
    # Do not run the schedule job on forks
    if: github.repository == 'dask/dask' || github.event_name != 'schedule'

    # If you change the pattern of this name, please adjust
    # ../distributed/continuous_integration/scripts/test_report.py accordingly
    name: ${{ matrix.os }} ${{ matrix.environment }} ${{ matrix.task }}
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 90
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        # Note: after adding/removing builds here, update
        # codecov.yml to match.
        os: [ubuntu-latest, ubuntu-24.04-arm, windows-latest]
        environment: [py310, py311, py312, py313, py314, py315]
        task: [test-ci]
        include:
          # MacOS CI does not have many hosts available; run it only once
          - os: macos-latest
            environment: py315
            task: test-ci
          # Minimum dependencies
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            environment: mindeps-array
            task: test-ci
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            environment: mindeps-dataframe
            task: test-ci
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            environment: mindeps-distributed
            task: test-ci
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            environment: mindeps-non-optional
            task: test-ci
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            environment: mindeps-optional
            task: test-ci
          # Experimental setups
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            environment: py315
            task: test-array-expr
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            environment: mindeps-array
            task: test-array-expr
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            environment: py314t
            task: test-ci
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            environment: py315t
            task: test-ci
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            environment: spark
            task: test-spark

    steps:
      - name: Checkout source
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0  # Needed by codecov.io

      - name: Reconfigure pytest-timeout
        # No SIGALRM available on Windows
        # Note: all changes to the source code must happen before setup-pixi
        # or we'll build the package twice
        if: ${{ matrix.os != 'windows-latest' }}
        run: sed -i.bak 's/timeout_method = "thread"/timeout_method = "signal"/' pyproject.toml

      - uses: prefix-dev/setup-pixi@v0.11.3
        with:
          pixi-version: v0.85.0
          environments: ${{ matrix.environment }}
          cache: true
          locked: true

      - name: Run tests
        id: run_tests
        run: pixi run -e ${{ matrix.environment }} ${{ matrix.task }}
  
      - name: Coverage
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v7
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}

      - name: Upload test results
        # ensure this runs even if pytest fails
        if: >
          always() &&
          (steps.run_tests.

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
